lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਤਉ ਸਰਣੀ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: har naam hiradai pavitr paavan ihu sareer tau saranee ||7||
lines.translation: The Name of the Lord, the most pure and sacred, is within my heart; this body is Your Sanctuary, Lord. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਬ ਲੋਭ ਲਹਰਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਣੰ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਾਸਿ ਮਨੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: lab lobh lahar nivaarana(n) har naam raas mana(n) ||
lines.translation: The waves of greed and avarice are subdued, by treasuring the Lord's Name in the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਤੁਹੀ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਰਨੰ ॥੮॥੧॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: man maar tuhee nira(n)janaa kahu naanakaa sarana(n) ||8||1||5||
lines.translation: Subdue my mind, O Pure Immaculate Lord; says Nanak, I have entered Your Sanctuary. ||8||1||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 3 ghar 1 ||
lines.translation: Goojaree, Third Mehl, First House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਚਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: nirat karee ihu man nachaaee ||
lines.translation: I dance, and make this mind dance as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee aap gavaaee ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, I eliminate my self-conceit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਿਤੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋ ਇਛੀ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: chit thir raakhai so mukat hovai jo ichhee soee phal paaee ||1||
lines.translation: One who keeps his consciousness focused on the Lord is liberated; he obtains the fruits of his desires. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਚੁ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਆਗੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naach re man gur kai aagai ||
lines.translation: So dance, O mind, before your Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਨਾਚਹਿ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਅੰਤੇ ਜਮ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai bhaanai naachahi taa sukh paavahi a(n)te jam bhau bhaagai || rahaau ||
lines.translation: If you dance according to the Guru's Will, you shall obtain peace, and in the end, the fear of death shall leave you. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਨਚਾਏ ਸੋ ਭਗਤੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਆਪਣਾ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap nachaae so bhagat kaheeai aapanaa piaar aap laae ||
lines.translation: One whom the Lord Himself causes to dance, is called a devotee. He Himself links us to His Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗਾਵੈ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਅੰਧੇ ਕਉ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aape gaavai aap sunaavai is man a(n)dhe kau maarag paae ||2||
lines.translation: He Himself sings, He Himself listens, and He puts this blind mind on the right path. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਚੈ ਸਕਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਸਿਵ ਘਰਿ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin naachai sakat nivaarai siv ghar need na hoee ||
lines.translation: One who dances night and day, and banishes Shakti's Maya, enters the House of the Lord Shiva, where there is no sleep.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਕਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਸੂਤਾ ਨਾਚੈ ਟਾਪੈ ਅਵਰੋ ਗਾਵੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sakatee ghar jagat sootaa naachai taapai avaro gaavai manamukh bhagat na hoee ||3||
lines.translation: The world is asleep in Maya, the house of Shakti; it dances, jumps and sings in duality. The self-willed manmukh has no devotion. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਵਿਰਤਿ ਪਖਿ ਕਰਮੀ ਨਾਚੇ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sur nar virat pakh karamee naache mun jan giaan beechaaree ||
lines.translation: The angels, mortals, renunciates, ritualists, silent sages and beings of spiritual wisdom dance.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਨਾਚੇ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: sidh saadhik liv laagee naache jin guramukh budh veechaaree ||4||
lines.translation: The Siddhas and seekers, lovingly focused on the Lord, dance, as do the Gurmukhs, whose minds dwell in reflective meditation. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਚੇ ਜਿਨ ਲਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kha(n)d brahama(n)d trai gun naache jin laagee har liv tumaaree ||
lines.translation: The planets and solar systems dance in the three qualities, as do those who bear love for You, Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭੇ ਹੀ ਨਾਚੇ ਨਾਚਹਿ ਖਾਣੀ ਚਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabhe hee naache naachahi khaanee chaaree ||5||
lines.translation: The beings and creatures all dance, and the four sources of creation dance. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਸੇਈ ਨਾਚਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo tudh bhaavahi seee naachahi jin guramukh sabad liv laae ||
lines.translation: They alone dance, who are pleasing to You, and who, as Gurmukhs, embrace love for the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੇ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਏ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: se bhagat se tat giaanee jin kau hukam manaae ||6||
lines.translation: They are devotees, with the essence of spiritual wisdom, who obey the Hukam of His Command. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ehaa bhagat sache siu liv laagai bin sevaa bhagat na hoee ||
lines.translation: This is devotional worship, that one loves the True Lord; without service, one cannot be a devotee.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: jeevat marai taa sabad beechaarai taa sach paavai koee ||7||
lines.translation: If one remains dead while yet alive, he reflects upon the Shabad, and then, he obtains the True Lord. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਅਰਥਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਲੋਕ ਨਾਚੇ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa kai arath bahut lok naache ko viralaa tat beechaaree ||
lines.translation: So many people dance for the sake of Maya; how rare are those who contemplate reality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee soee jan paae jin kau kripaa tumaaree ||8||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, that humble being obtains You, Lord, upon whom You show Mercy. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਦਮੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਸਾ ਵੇਲਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik dam saachaa veesarai saa velaa birathaa jaai ||
lines.translation: If I forget the True Lord, even for an instant, that time passes in vain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿ ਸਾਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: saahi saahi sadaa samaaleeai aape bakhase kare rajaai ||9||
lines.translation: With each and every breath, constantly remember the Lord; He Himself shall forgive you, according to His Will. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਈ ਨਾਚਹਿ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: seee naachahi jo tudh bhaavahi j guramukh sabad veechaaree ||
lines.translation: They alone dance, who are pleasing to Your Will, and who, as Gurmukhs, contemplate the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੧੦॥੧॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak se sahaj sukh paavahi jin kau nadar tumaaree ||10||1||6||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, they alone find celestial peace, whom You bless with Your Grace. ||10||1||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 4 ghar 2 ||
lines.translation: Goojaree, Fourth Mehl, Second House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਅਰਾ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਖੀਰ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bin jeearaa rahi na sakai jiu baalak kheer adhaaree ||
lines.translation: Without the Lord, my soul cannot survive, like an infant without milk.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: agam agochar prabh guramukh paaeeai apune satigur kai balihaaree ||1||
lines.translation: The inaccessible and incomprehensible Lord God is obtained by the Gurmukh; I am a sacrifice to my True Guru. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: man re har keerat tar taaree ||
lines.translation: O my mind, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise is a boat to carry you across.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh naam a(n)mrit jal paaeeai jin kau kripaa tumaaree || rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs obtain the Ambrosial Water of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. You bless them with Your Grace. ||Pause||
